title: Pole-impact crash benchmark: quantities and displacement fields
description: A bumper beam on two crash boxes driven into a rigid pole: seven design variables to the crashworthiness quantities, and the undeformed mesh to the displacement sequence of every node. Tabular families and field surrogates are compared on the same campaign, with the part hierarchy the hierarchical surrogate exploits.
methods: explicit hexahedral dynamics (J2 plasticity, penalty contact)
